evals.prompt: A proposed design uses #888888 text on #ffffff background. Can we approve it without running contrast verification?
evals.expected_output: Rejects unverified color pairs; computes WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratio (failing the 4.5:1 threshold for normal text) and APCA lightness contrast, requiring token adjustment.
expectations: Rejects visual designs that fail WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
Computes exact contrast ratios and APCA lightness metrics.
Requires fail-closed verification before UI approval.

evals.prompt: Perform a contrast audit on primary button and badge styles across both light and dark themes.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates text and surface contrast in both light and dark modes, ensuring minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal body copy and 3.0:1 for large text/icons.
expectations: Audits both light and dark color modes.
Verifies compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA and APCA criteria.
Outputs concise machine-readable pass/fail audit results.
